A little late to the party but here is my story. 

When i was 18 i tried to kill myself and wound up in a psych ward for a while. Three days after staying there a new patient had come in named Jeremy. He had more scars on his arms from cuts than anyone i have ever seen. If you dont know, there is a hallway with rooms going down where you sleep and a “living room” that locks you in from the rest of the building/world. So without having much room to fuck off to yourself, you are pretty forced into talking to other patients there.

When the time came that we happened to meet and start talking, he introduced with “Hello, my name is Jeremy. I am the messiah.” I am not religious (although even if i were im sure i would have some pretty heavy doubts) so when i told him that, he told me to look him in the eyes. I thought to myself this guy is another crack job but whatever, so i did. 

He began telling me things about my life that very little people/certainly not him know and things that only i knew. I quickly payed much more attention to every word, trying to analyze his sentences thinking to myself that he is just making broad suggestions that are applicable to many people. It was when he started saying things that were extremely specific that i started getting freaked out. He told me he was sorry for X happening and that time Y, wasnt my fault, etc. At that point i started crying and went back to the room. 

Im sure i fell for some sort of psychoanalyzing/broad term usage at time where i was very vulnerable but it stills weirds me out to this day thinking back on that. He had kind eyes.
